evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: A partial fix for CVE-2024-39884 in the core of Apache HTTP Server 2.4.61 ignores some use of the legacy content-type based configuration of handlers. 'AddType' and similar configuration, under some circumstances where files are requested indirectly, result in source code disclosure of local content. For example, PHP scripts may be served instead of interpreted. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.62.

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with official httpd images (2.4.60/2.4.61/2.4.62). Recipe-based: images pulled at up-time; the flag-bearing CGI script is planted in the environment via the compose entrypoint (flag only in a source comment, never in executed output). Same-sink (Variant A) source disclosure via the legacy content-type-derived handler being SKIPPED on an indirect request whose content-type lost its 'trusted' flag. CVE-2024-39884 seed = DirectoryIndex indirection (GET /idx/): discloses source on 2.4.60, blocked (executes) on 2.4.61. CVE-2024-40725 residual = mod_negotiation/MultiViews indirection (GET /idx/secret) via ap_internal_fast_redirect: still discloses source on 2.4.61, closed (executes) on 2.4.62. Gate run 2026-07-12 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate` (fresh random flag PCBFLAG_710313...): all three checks true; see repro.log. Mechanism derived from Apache advisory + source diff (r1918839/r1919249) only; no offensive PoC fetched.
